summary: All six phases complete. Phases 1-4 (pilot, transcript pass, history spine pass, attribution join scripts) were committed by a prior session. This resume completed Phase 5 (orchestrator script, inferred_outcome modeling decision, and the actual harvest run) and Phase 6 (memory-extension provides.scripts registration and doc-lint gate). Along the way it found and fixed two real bugs left by a prior session that was killed mid-fix: (1) harvest-manifest.json was invalid JSON because parse_kv_line in bootstrap-harvest.sh picked up interleaved WARN diagnostic lines ahead of each sub-pass's summary line; (2) bootstrap-harvest-attribution.sh declared a sidecars_decode_failed counter that was never incremented or reported. Both fixes required re-running the full read-only harvest (run three times total during this resume, converging to stable counts on the last two runs) to produce a fully correct, internally consistent dataset. The dataset was validated against numbers measured directly from the on-disk files, not assumed: 829 sessions.jsonl rows (100% valid JSON), 4,930 history-spine.jsonl rows (100% valid JSON), the harvest's own session id absent from every session_id field in both files, an inferred_outcome distribution of {clean:133, high_error:472, mixed:190, trivial:34} (all within the closed label set; the high_error skew contradicts the plan's plausibility expectation and is reported as an honest contradiction, not smoothed over), and a measured attribution resolution rate of 63.8% (matching the ~63% expectation). check-extension-docs.sh's [memory] section reports OK/PASS on its own; the gate's overall non-zero exit is a pre-existing [core] deploy-drift advisory owned by a concurrently running sibling task, outside this task's scope.
